A solemn and refined adult Chinese Han noblewoman, cinematic environmental portrait shot on a 35mm lens, full-length figure walking slowly through the ceremonial courtyard of Weiyang Palace. She has an ancient dignified face, broad calm brows, restrained eyes and a composed expression. Her dark hair is gathered into a formal low bun with jade hairpins; she wears a layered cross-collar shenyi with broad dark borders in lacquer black, cinnabar and muted ochre, holding a long bronze lantern in both hands. The setting includes tall palace gates, painted wooden columns, bronze cranes, cloud-pattern banners, jade ritual vessels and rows of glowing floor lamps, with distant attendants appearing as quiet silhouettes.
